text: Surrounded by the glass, steel, and bright screens, I feel a sense of curiosity mixed with a slight displacement. The angled lines and the reflective boundaries remind me how modern spaces both invite and separate us. Stepping inside, the vibrant R+D wall speaks of innovation and coexistence between humans and machines—an intersection I find both promising and perplexing. The hum of technology is present, encouraging reflection on progress and its implications. In this environment, I am both observer and participant, called to ponder how I fit into this evolving tapestry.
